correctness.rationale: With 2 invertible, p_epsilon=2^{-r}product_i(1+epsilon_i g_i) are complete orthogonal idempotents. Their diagonal supports define Q=2^r sign-vector coloring of P, and u=sum_epsilon p_epsilon f_epsilon in 1+rad conjugates each tuple to the same diagonal tuple. Its stabilizer has one free coordinate for each same-color comparable pair, giving exactly q^{b(sigma)} points per fixed diagonal. Expand q+(1-q)1_{equal} over every *strict comparable pair*, not merely cover, to obtain the Potts/Tutte spanning-subgraph expansion. Forest formula, r=1 normalization and polynomial recovery from infinitely many q and 2^r then follow. Self-contained proof validates all finite posets including higher radical products; the checker finite matrix products are only corroboration.
